title: Hold Settings by Resupply Schedule (PAP Supply Replenishment Program)
content:
Two hold settings of the PAP Supply Replenishment Program vary by resupply schedule: whether shipments stop while the patient is an inpatient or in skilled nursing, and how many calendar days an enrollment may stay on hold before it is cancelled.

| Schedule | Shipments stop during an inpatient or skilled-nursing stay | Most calendar days on hold before cancellation |
|---|---|---|
| Medicare Part B Resupply Schedule | yes | 90 |
| Medicare Advantage Resupply Schedule | yes | 90 |
| Medicaid Resupply Schedule | yes | 60 |
| Commercial HMO Resupply Schedule | yes | 90 |
| Commercial PPO Resupply Schedule | yes | 90 |
| Self-Pay Supply Subscription | no | 30 |

## Comparing the schedules

- The inpatient or skilled-nursing stop applies on every coverage schedule and not on the Self-Pay Supply Subscription.
- The longest hold an enrollment may carry is 90 calendar days on the Medicare Part B, Medicare Advantage, Commercial HMO and Commercial PPO schedules, 60 on the Medicaid Resupply Schedule and 30 on the Self-Pay Supply Subscription.
